title: claude-house check result
description: Returned by checks/<id>.ps1 and printed by `house check <id> --json`. Read-only proof that one runbook step is done.

status.description: Set by the CLI: blocked when a required step does not pass.

fix.description: Runbook anchor or exact command that addresses the failure.

evidence.description: Raw observed facts (booleans, counts, versions). Never secrets.
